summary: Map features from a public OGC API - Features collection or WFS layer the operator approved (for example PDOK), read as a feature set in the coordinate system the service states, with the service's licence named.

host.name: OGC API - Features and WFS 2.0 (PDOK, NLOG)

losses: Positions in the coordinate system the service states; nothing is transformed
Nested property values are kept only in the exact original
Only the first 10,000 features of a collection are read; the report says when more exist
Read from the service as it answers on the day; an older version is kept only once copied in
Every copy carries the service's licence as its own documents state it, or says it is not stated
unsupported: a coordinate system the service reprojects with an offset (NLOG: its own system only)

qualification.evidence: connectors:tests/test_repository_ogc.py (recorded NLOG WFS and PDOK exchanges, 12 October 2026; loopback services)

redistribution: As the service's licence states: PDOK Bestuurlijke Gebieden under CC BY 4.0 (name Kadaster / PDOK and link the licence); NLOG under its disclaimer (quote NLOG.NL as the source).
